blockingIssues.description: The new unauthenticated public-detail test expects a redirect to `/auth/signin?redirectedFrom=/bookings/recover?...`, but the handoff and manual verification claim the route redirected directly back to `/auth/signin?redirectedFrom=/bookings/[bookingId]`. Because this feature only added tests and did not change the route implementation, it did not actually deliver the direct public return-target behavior required by the feature contract; that behavior was only fixed later by a follow-up feature.

The feature contract includes keeping restaurant thank-you aliases on one canonical route, but this feature's diff and added tests only cover public booking and guest thank-you redirects plus receipt messaging. The restaurant alias implementation existed already and remained unverified here, so the feature does not fully satisfy its assigned contract on its own.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The `guest-ui-worker` skill requires a targeted RED test run before implementation, but the transcript shows the worker added the new test file and first ran it only after implementation. The skill guidance may need stronger emphasis or examples for test-only features.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Transcript skeleton for worker session `b196dee9-8565-422e-bd28-ef8d7db710a0`: `ApplyPatch` created `tests/guest/public-booking-pages.test.tsx` before the first `pnpm exec vitest run tests/guest/public-booking-pages.test.tsx --reporter=verbose` invocation.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The worker had to discover the real booking dialog import location after initially assuming `src/components/features/dashboard/*Dialog*.tsx`; this import-path quirk is not captured in shared library notes even though it affects booking-detail test setup.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Transcript skeleton shows failed `Glob`/`Grep` searches under `src/components/features/dashboard` followed by reading `src/components/features/dashboard/booking-details/BookingDialog.tsx` to locate the actual dialog exports used by `ReservationDetailClient`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The mission library documents `/restaurants/[slug]/thank-you` canonicalization, but there was no dedicated scrutiny evidence tied to this feature until a later follow-up feature covered it. That gap made it easy for this worker to mark the feature complete without proving the restaurant alias behavior required by the contract.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: .factory/library/guest-routes.md lists `/restaurants/[slug]/thank-you` as canonicalizing to `/restaurants/[slug]/book/thank-you`, while commit `98fc48a7` only changed `ReceiptClient.tsx`, `tests/guest/guest-receipt-pages.test.tsx`, and `tests/e2e/guest-receipt-pages.spec.ts`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The `guest-ui-worker` procedure still appears easy to misapply around environment initialization and post-change validation breadth. In this transcript the worker invoked `.factory/init.sh` with `python3` and skipped the post-change full `npx vitest run --maxWorkers=9`, then reported both as skill feedback rather than following the documented shell invocation and broader-validator step literally.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Transcript skeleton for session `f11ba3b9-a9f9-4580-9ef7-2b7b6d6a668d` shows `python3 "/Users/.../.factory/init.sh"` failing early, and the recorded post-change commands include only targeted `tests/guest/public-booking-pages.test.tsx`, Playwright, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm lint` before commit. `guest-ui-worker/SKILL.md` step 6 explicitly lists rerunning `npx vitest run --maxWorkers=9` after implementation.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The worker skipped the guest-ui-worker skill's tests-first RED step and agent-browser step. For this non-UI test-fixture cleanup that only edits an existing unit test, the skill procedure appears broader than necessary and could explicitly allow targeted automated verification without browser work.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Handoff `skillFeedback` marks `followedProcedure: false` because the worker reproduced the warning via baseline/full Vitest and then updated the existing test fixture directly, and skipped agent-browser since no guest-facing runtime surface changed. Commit b35e0799 changes only `tests/guest/guest-receipt-pages.test.tsx`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Booking-recovery continuity depends on SESSION_RECOVERY_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET, and later validators rely on it, so the shared environment/testing notes need to keep that prerequisite explicit.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: src/app/(public)/bookings/[bookingId]/page.tsx:49-64 mints continuation tokens only when SESSION_RECOVERY_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET is present; .factory/library/environment.md documents that prerequisite and .factory/library/user-testing.md notes /dev/booking-recovery shows a missing-secret message without it.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The recovery-secret dependency is still accessed inconsistently across the booking recovery flow: the dev harness now uses `env.security.sessionRecoveryAccessTokenSecret`, but public booking detail revisit continuity still reads `process.env.SESSION_RECOVERY_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET` directly instead of the same canonical env accessor.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: `src/app/(public)/dev/booking-recovery/page.tsx:32` uses `env.security.sessionRecoveryAccessTokenSecret`, while `src/app/(public)/bookings/[bookingId]/page.tsx:49-64` still reads `process.env.SESSION_RECOVERY_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET?.trim()` before creating continuation tokens.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The `guest-routing-worker` skill currently requires `agent-browser` verification for route work, but this sitemap-only metadata cleanup had no browser-visible surface. The worker reasonably used deterministic sitemap inspection plus tests instead.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: `.factory/skills/guest-routing-worker/SKILL.md` step 7 requires browser verification; handoff `2026-03-25T13-52-07-569Z__remove-deprecated-guest-thank-you-from-sitemap__db5d1d7d-ae31-41fb-9c9f-f2ce644eef48.json` records a justified deviation because the feature only changed `src/app/sitemap.ts` and added `tests/app/sitemap.test.ts`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Shared route documentation remains inconsistent about which restaurant thank-you URL is canonical. Current runtime/tests/library treat `/restaurants/[slug]/book/thank-you` as canonical, while the ADR still says `/restaurants/:slug/thank-you` is canonical.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: .factory/library/guest-routes.md:20 says `/restaurants/[slug]/thank-you` canonicalizes to `/restaurants/[slug]/book/thank-you`; docs/adr/2025-12-03-guest-route-naming.md:17 says `/restaurants/:slug/thank-you` is canonical and `/restaurants/:slug/book/thank-you` is legacy; src/app/(public)/(marketing)/restaurants/[slug]/thank-you/page.tsx:8-13 and tests/e2e/guest-public-marketing.spec.ts:27-35 confirm the implemented canonical destination is `/restaurants/[slug]/book/thank-you`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The guest-routing-worker skill does not clearly say that a proof-only feature may be completed by validating existing route and browser coverage without adding a new RED test first, even though this mission used that path successfully.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The feature handoff marks skillFeedback.followedProcedure=false because the worker validated pre-existing coverage instead of writing a new failing test; .factory/skills/guest-routing-worker/SKILL.md step 9 allows validated test-only coverage when behavior already satisfies the contract, but step 4 still reads as mandatory RED-first without this proof-only exception.

orchestratorOverride.reason: Override accepted after follow-up fixes and proof-only validation closed the real booking-lifecycle gaps. The remaining failed reviews are stale feature-local history: `public-bookings-home-and-detail` was superseded by `fix-public-booking-detail-return-intent`, `fix-booking-recovery-final-destination`, and `preserve-booking-recovery-continuity-after-token-strip`, while `guest-receipt-and-thank-you-canonicalization` was completed by later `canonicalize-deprecated-guest-thank-you-alias`, `remove-deprecated-guest-thank-you-from-sitemap`, and `cover-restaurant-thank-you-alias-canonicalization` work. Milestone validators are green and no unresolved product defects remain in the scrutiny findings.
